issues.failure_explanation:
The right-hand side of eq:Enrichment controls $v_h-\mathcal{E}v_h$ only through tangential jumps of $
abla_h v_h$ across interior faces. Since $\mathcal{E}$ maps into $S^1_0$, $(\mathcal{E}v_h)(j)=0$ at boundary vertices, while the CR conditions force only $v_h(\mathrm{mid}(\gamma'))=0$ at boundary face midpoints, so $v_h$ may take a common nonzero value $c$ at a boundary vertex $j$ on all elements of the patch. Using the free CR midpoint degrees of freedom one can build $v_h\in V_h$ that is locally affine near an element $T
i j$ with value $c
eq0$ at $j$, vanishes at the adjacent boundary midpoints, and has zero value jumps (hence zero tangential gradient jumps) on every interior face touching $T$, with the nonzero jumps placed on faces outside the sum. For such $v_h$ the left-hand side of eq:Enrichment is $\gtrsim\phi_a(|c|/h_T)>0$ while the right-hand side is $0$, so the estimate is false. The proof's vertex bound $|v_h(j)-\mathcal{E}v_h(j)|\le(\max-\min)/2$ via jumps of face neighbors is valid only at interior vertices; at boundary vertices $\mathcal{E}v_h(j)=0$ is not controlled by any term of the estimate.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Extend the right-hand side of eq:Enrichment to control boundary-vertex values (e.g. add tangential jumps over boundary faces with zero exterior trace, or stability terms $\phi_a(|\nabla_h v_h|)$ on boundary-touching elements), verify the vertex bound also at boundary vertices, and propagate the extra terms through the proof of eq:Enrichment2, where they are bounded by the same bubble/curl arguments or absorbed in the applications. All theorem statements remain unchanged.
issues.overall_effect: eq:Enrichment is false for boundary-adjacent elements of any polygonal domain; since its proof underpins eq:Enrichment2 in lem:confComp, the proofs of thm:mainResult, thm:Apriori, thm:ApproxProperties and thm:AprioriConf are not established as written.
issues.title: Enrichment estimate eq:Enrichment is false at boundary vertices
issues.why_classification: The lemma is false as stated, but a local modification of its right-hand side plus a contained extension of the existing proof repairs it, preserving every theorem, rate and advertised scope; the falsity and required propagation exceed a routine typo-level fix.

issues.failure_explanation:
Lemma lem:confComp delivers the divergence contribution in conjugate form $\int(\phi_{|
abla_h v_h|})^*(h|\div A(
abla v)|)$, but the proof of thm:ApproxProperties (eq:ProofTemp0223) asserts the plain modulus $\int\phi_{|
abla v|}(h|\div A(
abla v)|)$ instead. Plain and conjugate shifted N-functions are not equivalent (for $\phi(t)=t^p/p$, $\phi_{|Q|}(t)\sim|Q|^{p-2}t^2$ whereas $(\phi_{|Q|})^*(t)\sim|Q|^{2-p}t^2$ in the quadratic regime), so the stated bound is not established. The proof of thm:AprioriConf then applies lem:Oscillation, which bounds only the conjugate $\int(\phi)^*(h|f|)$, to the plain term $\int\phi_{|
abla_h\Inc u|}(h|f|)$; this is quantitatively false, since with data of size $\Lambda$ ($|
abla u|\sim\Lambda$, $|f|\sim\Lambda^{p-1}$) the plain term scales like $\Lambda^{3p-4}h^2$ while error and oscillation scale like $\Lambda^ph^2$.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: State thm:ApproxProperties with the conjugate divergence term $\int(\phi_{|\nabla v|})^*(h_\tria|\div A(\nabla v)|)\,dx$ as delivered by lem:confComp, and rewrite the final displays of the proof of thm:AprioriConf by applying lem:Oscillation (both bounds, with $v_h=\Inc u$) to the conjugate term; thm:AprioriConf's statement then follows unchanged.
issues.overall_effect: thm:ApproxProperties is unproven as stated (its divergence term is not the quantity delivered by the analysis), and the final estimates in the proof of thm:AprioriConf are invalid as written.
issues.title: thm:ApproxProperties states a plain $\phi$ divergence term where the analysis yields the conjugate $(\phi)^*$
issues.why_classification: The theorem's divergence term must be replaced (a limited alteration of the stated bound, not a routine typo, since $\phi$ and $(\phi)^*$ are inequivalent), but the downstream result thm:AprioriConf survives verbatim and the repair is contained; no rate or scope is lost.
